facts.fact: TechTrends KE reports the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner was established under the Data Protection Act, 2019, with inaugural commissioner Immaculate Kassait in office since 2020 and a Senior Deputy Data Commissioner serving; the Public Service Commission shortlisted 13 of 152 applicants to succeed her.
